nodes.name: Global State Corporation
nodes.purpose: Independent record label; owns the music catalog and music business operations.

nodes.name: Global State Solutions
nodes.purpose: Project management company; coordinates and allocates resources, capital, and strategic direction across the subsidiary entities.

nodes.name: Global State Productions
nodes.purpose: Production company; produces all visual content for the enterprise.

nodes.name: Global State Systems
nodes.purpose: Technology company; owns Jericho system development.

nodes.name: Global State Holdings
nodes.purpose: Real estate company; responsible for property acquisition and management for the enterprise.

nodes.name: Global State Academy
nodes.purpose: Private school company and franchise; manages school operations and franchise expansion.

nodes.name: F8 Energy Company
nodes.purpose: Consumer energy products company; produces F8 Energy GUM and manages sales and marketing operations.

nodes.name: Global State Solutions Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Solutions a defined operational identity.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Solutions' own business plan and brand identity.

nodes.name: Help Yourself Broadcast Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Help Yourself Broadcast a defined operational identity as its own audience-facing venture.
nodes.function: Establishes Help Yourself Broadcast's own business plan and brand identity, distinct from Global State Productions' general identity.

nodes.name: Help Yourself Broadcast
nodes.objective: Converts listener attention into Help Yourself audience growth and directs it toward Global State's owned channels.
nodes.function: Produces and airs a recurring podcast broadcast.
nodes.ongoing_output: Recurring episode output; sustained audience engagement feeding the flywheel indefinitely.

nodes.name: Global State Corporation Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Corporation a defined operational identity separate from Our Fearless Leader, Seeds of Destruction, and I Am The State outputs.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Corporation's own business plan and brand identity, distinct from any single release.

nodes.name: State of Control Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives State of Control a defined operational identity as its own standing venture.
nodes.function: Establishes State of Control's own business plan and brand identity, distinct from Our Fearless Leader's Foundation coverage.

nodes.name: The Jericho System
nodes.objective: Gives the enterprise one execution engine instead of scattered, ungoverned plans across ventures.
nodes.function: Orchestrates the multi-lane master plan system across all enterprise lanes; runs the execution engine the enterprise operates on.
nodes.ongoing_output: Runs live plan generation and priority ranking for every lane; sustains subscription/licensing revenue tied to the system once operational.

nodes.name: Global State Productions Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Productions a defined operational identity separate from Help Yourself Broadcast and The Imaginary CEO outputs.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Productions' own business plan and brand identity, distinct from any single production.

nodes.name: Global State Systems Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Systems a defined operational identity separate from The Jericho System output.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Systems' own business plan and brand identity, distinct from The Jericho System's output.

nodes.name: Global State Holdings Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Holdings a defined operational identity.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Holdings' own business plan and brand identity, distinct from any single property.

nodes.name: Marketing Flywheel Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the flywheel a defined operational identity as Global State Solutions' first owned product function.
nodes.function: Establishes the flywheel's own business plan and brand identity, distinct from Global State Solutions' general identity.

nodes.name: Global State Academy Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Academy a defined operational identity.
nodes.function: Establishes Global State Academy's own business plan and brand identity, separate from any single building.

nodes.name: F8 Energy Company Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives F8 Energy Company a defined operational identity.
nodes.function: Establishes F8 Energy Company's own business plan and brand identity.

nodes.name: 79th Street Renovation
nodes.objective: Establishes Global State Holdings' physical real-estate footprint and houses both HQ and the Academy.
nodes.function: Acquires and restores property along 79th Street, starting with the First Building, from 79th and Stony Island to Exchange.
nodes.ongoing_output: Ongoing property holdings and physical infrastructure supporting HQ and Academy operations indefinitely.

nodes.name: First Academy Building Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the building its own defined strategy as Global State Academy's first physical venture.
nodes.function: Establishes First Academy Building's own business plan, distinct from Global State Academy's general identity.

nodes.name: Our Fearless Leader: 7 Seals Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the tape series its own defined strategy as Global State Corporation's first real venture.
nodes.function: Establishes Our Fearless Leader: 7 Seals' own business plan, distinct from Global State Corporation's general identity.

nodes.name: The Imaginary CEO Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the series its own defined strategy as an audience-facing venture.
nodes.function: Establishes The Imaginary CEO's own business plan, distinct from Global State Productions' general identity.

nodes.name: Seeds of Destruction Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the trilogy its own defined strategy for its higher-complexity era.
nodes.function: Establishes Seeds of Destruction's own business plan, distinct from Global State Corporation's general identity.

nodes.name: Marketing Flywheel — Audience Capture
nodes.objective: Gives Global State Solutions a concrete owned output that directly feeds the financial funnel it already owns.
nodes.function: Builds and operates cross-venture audience-capture infrastructure (pre-save, platform follow, app signup).
nodes.ongoing_output: Continuous audience capture feeding the financial funnel indefinitely.

nodes.name: Our Fearless Leader: 7 Seals
nodes.objective: Establishes Global State Corporation's label identity and builds the core audience the rest of the music catalog depends on.
nodes.function: Produces and releases the Our Fearless Leader tape series (tapes 1-7).
nodes.completion_value: All 7 tapes shipped, with a proven, built audience.

nodes.name: I Am The State Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the terminal album its own defined strategy as the closing chapter of the enterprise's arc.
nodes.function: Establishes I Am The State's own business plan and brand identity, distinct from Global State Corporation's general identity.

nodes.name: F8 Energy GUM Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives GUM its own defined strategy as F8's first product venture.
nodes.function: Establishes GUM's own business plan, distinct from F8 Energy Company's general identity.

nodes.name: Desiree Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the feature film its own defined strategy as the terminal arc's visual capstone.
nodes.function: Establishes Desiree's own business plan, distinct from Global State Productions' general identity.

nodes.name: State of Control
nodes.objective: Gives the campaign its own operational identity, separate from Our Fearless Leader's music-focused venture.
nodes.function: Produces the ongoing State of Control visual series, paired with each Our Fearless Leader tape release.

nodes.name: The Imaginary CEO
nodes.objective: Advertises the Jericho system by dramatizing its real use.
nodes.function: Produces a scripted reality/documentary series following the execution of the enterprise's initiatives.
nodes.completion_value: Season 8 airs covering I Am The State and is published to the Global State YouTube channel.

nodes.name: Seeds of Destruction
nodes.objective: Extends the label's narrative arc into its second era, building on the audience Our Fearless Leader established.
nodes.function: Produces the Seeds of Destruction album trilogy alongside the Max Clout short-film trilogy.
nodes.completion_value: Album trilogy and Max Clout short-film trilogy both shipped.

nodes.name: F8 Energy GUM
nodes.objective: Creates an institutional revenue stream from product sales.
nodes.function: Produces the energy gum product line and manages its business operations.
nodes.ongoing_output: Operational production-to-distribution chain for consumable energy products.

nodes.name: First Academy Building
nodes.objective: Seats Global State Academy's first enrolled cohort at 79th and Essex.
nodes.function: Secures the 79th and Essex property as the site for the Academy's first physical campus and Global State Solutions headquarters.
nodes.ongoing_output: Real estate property and education business revenue.

nodes.name: 79th Street Renovation Foundation
nodes.objective: Gives the acquisition its own defined strategy as Global State Holdings' first real-estate deal.
nodes.function: Establishes 79th Street's own business plan, distinct from Global State Holdings' general identity.

nodes.name: I Am The State
nodes.objective: Releases the terminal album alongside the Desiree film as the final chapter of the Our Fearless Leader to I Am The State story.
nodes.function: Produces the terminal album and the Desiree feature film closing the enterprise's creative arc.
nodes.completion_value: Terminal album released; Desiree feature film released; arc complete.

nodes.name: Music System
nodes.mechanism: Writing/recording → mix/master → tape release on the Our Fearless Leader cadence

nodes.name: Production System
nodes.mechanism: Concept/script → shoot/edit → shipped visual deliverable (short films, episodes, features)

nodes.name: Software System
nodes.mechanism: Build → ship → iterate on Jericho and apps
nodes.feeds_converges_into: Financial Funnel System (software sales → Global State Solutions); Execution Feedback System

nodes.name: Financial Funnel System
nodes.mechanism: Revenue from every venture → collected → allocated by Global State Solutions to entities and projects
nodes.feeds_converges_into: Global State Solutions — funds from software sales flow to the project management company

nodes.name: Execution Feedback System
nodes.mechanism: Global State Solutions operates on Jericho; Jericho improves from Global State Solutions's use

nodes.name: Marketing Flywheel
nodes.mechanism: Content (music/film/podcast/app) → audience discovery (editorial pitch, promo content batches, pre-save campaigns) → audience capture (multi-channel: pre-save, platform follow, app signup — not email-only) → cross-venture promotion (each release markets the next; The Imaginary CEO dramatizes Jericho; State of Control rides Our Fearless Leader's audience) → conversion (product/software sales) → revenue → reinvestment into next release, cascading up to the Global State Solutions parent brand

nodes.name: 79th Street Corridor System
nodes.mechanism: Acquire abandoned/distressed property → renovate/flip → hold or resell corridor-wide (Stony Island to Exchange)

nodes.name: Academy Site Acquisition System
nodes.mechanism: Acquire land/property specifically for Academy franchise expansion

nodes.name: Education System
nodes.mechanism: Acquire site (via Academy Site Acquisition System) → build/renovate → enroll students → operate school
nodes.feeds_converges_into: First Academy Building initiative; future Academy franchise sites

nodes.name: Consumer Products System
nodes.feeds_converges_into: F8 Energy GUM Production; future F8 product lines
